prompts.concrete_pores:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: single grayscale seamless tileable surface-detail texture for a Blender PBR texture-painting material, NOT a shaded material preview.
Output: one square 2048 by 2048 image, texture filling every pixel, opaque grayscale. Flat orthographic view. Opposite borders must match seamlessly. No perspective, object, sphere, frame, text, watermark, logos, directional lighting, glossy reflections, cast shadows, vignette, baked ambient occlusion, or broad brightness gradients. Black represents tiny recesses and pale gray represents raised grain; predominantly middle gray. Sharp natural surface detail, no artificial oversharpening. Exactly one texture, no sheet of maps.
Subject: a 30-centimeter patch of fine realistic cast concrete microstructure. Restrained multiscale mineral aggregate, tiny sand grains and sparse small irregular air pores, shallow pitting. Mostly even medium gray with delicate lighter mineral flecks and small dark pores. No large holes, cracks, stains, slab edges or recognizable decorative pattern. Fine natural scale, not boulders or coarse gravel. This scalar input will drive restrained concrete color, roughness and shallow height.

prompts.brushed_metal:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: grayscale tileable surface-detail source for a physically based texture-painting material, NOT a shaded material preview.
Primary request: Create a single square 2048 by 2048 texture of extremely fine, realistic brushed-metal microstructure. Thousands of restrained hairline abrasion marks run horizontally, with subtle irregular length and spacing and a few faint cross scratches. The visual scale is a 10-centimeter patch; brush grooves are microscopic, not thick stripes.
Composition: perfectly flat orthographic texture filling every pixel. Repeatable from left to right and top to bottom, matching opposite boundaries seamlessly, uniform statistical detail across the image. No object, panel edge, bevel, border, blank margin or center motif.
Values: neutral grayscale only, mid-gray average, subdued contrast; fine dark recessed lines and tiny light high points. No broad bands. This image is a scalar microstructure input that will drive independently calibrated roughness and height, so no reflections, directional illumination, specular hotspots, cast shadows, vignette, baked ambient occlusion or colored metal.
Quality: physically plausible organic machining variation, sharp fine texture without oversharpening. Opaque background. No text, symbols, logos or watermark. Exactly one texture, not a grid of maps.
